name: kettlebell romanian deadlift to squat
description: A Romanian deadlift flowing straight into a squat while holding a kettlebell. It trains the hips and thighs with a nice rhythm.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bell down your legs with a flat back.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat, keeping the bell close to your chest.
Stand up and repeat for the planned reps.
